lessons: The ticket contradicts itself: Scope in says the `tests` fence admits only the signal-fixture migration, and criterion 3 limits every edit under tests/ to naming a fixture's SIGNAL body. Criterion 1 and Regression require creating tests/test_vocabularies.py. Amend the ticket before retrying.

Re-author the CONTRADICTED TESTS bullet and criterion 3 so they exempt the new file tests/test_vocabularies.py by name. Keep the no-assertion-change rule for existing fixtures only. That way the three named tests in criterion 1 can be created.

The Regression block and Definition of rejected require the regression test to fail on the merge base, and tests/test_vocabularies.py is absent there. So the new file must be explicitly in scope. State that once in the fence prose rather than leaving it implicit.

After the ticket is amended, keep the rest of the scope unchanged: Dispatch Literal and dispatch_of in chupa/journal.py, match plus assert_never at every dispatch consumer, and SIGNAL_NAMES enforced in Journal.append. Section 6.2 still governs them.
